label: Actual inquiry: report fibers, distinct belief targets and thin epistemic reasons
summary: Inspected the actual displayed seven distinct research labels and executed the complete pairing with residue 1991. In the eight-prefix finite comparison, the full report nonvacuously and strictly entails odd parity; the pair-only report fails to entail either parity answer yet entails cardinality six or seven. This supplies a different belief content even when the original question remains unsettled, extending the prior hypothetical suspension comparison. The observed data and reproducible Python tests distinguish truth, intelligibility, local validity, correction, evidence-relative merit, normative favoring and preference-independent force. The three structural force assignments vary force while keeping the interpreted evidence fixed; they do not settle actual authority. F1 and thin F6 retain their scope and legacy status. Reused 146b502b and the same-relation nihilism distinction, 6b4e3331's support calibration and b50727e1's selected-world population route. Proposed elementary Lean projections are not registered or verified. No source claim, graph change, proof registration, new floor marking or root premise discharge. See docs/notes/actual-inquiry-presuppositions.md for exact scope, controls, derivations, commands and handoff. Continuation from 4947b398: the present conscious questioning, when actually apprehended as such, supplies evidence for its occurrence independently of the external truth of its target. Unlike a report or verdict, that factive evidence-kind cannot be retained in a thoughtless comparison state. The twelve-state structural control and all 2048 actual-containing restrictions passed; 1024 retain the designated deceptive external counterpart. Eight basis-defeat profiles show the separate epistemic uses of one episode: external representational support can be undercut while present-occurrence support survives. Distinct basis labels do not establish that separation, actual acquaintance or independent warrant. The local SurvivingBasisGivesReason calibration remains a substantive application. This is a cross-family warrant proposal for e81971f1 and F6, with the existing Cogito bearer and esse bridges unchanged. No new registered result; the proposed witness projections remain unelaborated. Continuation from 10532a8c: weakened the factive-thought-access route to genuine phenomenal seeming, including nonveridical content and a different episode of considering a skeptical objection. The weaker present phenomenal existential survives either witness, but the thought-specific bearer consumer 08cef374 cannot accept the broadened Occurs interpretation. Tested 64 two-episode states, 2736 nonempty conditional-probability cases, 1440 accuracy-score comparisons and eight structural reason/force assignments in Python. Every phenomenal primary or challenge witness entails the weak occurrence; report-only and misclassification controls preserve the distinction from thought, actual uptake, and propositionally available evidence. Conditional probability is 1 given the actual witness event of positive mass, and correct acceptance strictly beats incorrect acceptance in the specified score comparison even when suspension ties. Neither fact entails normative force or a subject's warranted recognition of the evidence. The positive local judgment concerns a competent subject actually investigating whether any experience occurs, who grasps the available presented instance's existential bearing. A critic conceding a genuine belief-directed reason for the defeater already grants F6 for another content; withholding alone does not. No concrete rebuttal or lack-of-indicativeness mechanism preserving actual phenomenal presence and competent access has been identified. Higher-order defeat of access and the nihilist's rejection of reason-giving merit remain distinct. No new registered theorem or premise marking.
blocker: Actual competent first-person access to the selected present phenomenon and its existential bearing are not observable here. The weak occurrence route does not require accurate classification as thought, but a mere marker or nonconceptual presence alone does not supply propositionally available evidence. A higher-order undercutter might attack the subject's access; external content-falsity alone cannot remove the weak occurrence while actual experience is retained. The substantive local reason attribution is strongly warranted prima facie on the eligible reading but cannot be deduced solely from the information/accuracy comparison; the nihilist can deny it and the goal-relative account can concede it without categorical authority. Independent semantic challenge, full local conventions/CLI, Lean and computed frontier delta unavailable.

current_assessment.scope: Local inquiry evidence from nonfactive phenomenal seeming, skeptical witness replacement, and its available existential bearing; thin F6, F1, and typed Cogito boundaries.
current_assessment.assessment: A genuine phenomenal seeming, including an illusory one, is itself an occurring experienced episode. If the original episode is misidentified or absent, a present experienced consideration of the objection supplies a new witness. The weak existential differs from the truth of a representation and from thought-specific occurrence. The evidence-preserving alternative and truth-accuracy comparison strongly support the ordinary local reason judgment when the competent subject actually investigates this existential and grasps its bearing. Actual phenomenal presence alone does not establish propositional access, reason, warrant or force. No specific defeating mechanism preserving both presence and competent access was identified; a denial of reason-giving merit remains a normative dispute, not a logical contradiction. A goal-relative rival can concede F6 in this inquiry. The broadened occurrence interpretation cannot be inserted into the thought-specific bearer route without a bridge.
current_assessment.next_test: Test a specified higher-order defeater on a competent subject actually investigating the weaker existential: does it remove or defeat their access to the available instance and its bearing, or preserve that access while denying all pro tanto reason-giving merit? Preserve a genuinely experienced assessment as a fresh witness and distinguish that from a bare marker. If the critic concedes a belief-directed reason for the defeater, record F6 for that different content. If they deny any such reason, compare the restrictive calibration without inferring falsity merely from retorsion. Obtain independent semantic challenge and run full preflight.
